prompt: A bakery scene with bakers and customers. A baker is kneading dough on a floured counter while wearing a white apron. Another baker is decorating a wedding cake with frosting, using a piping bag at a decorating station. This baker appears much fatter than the apprentice baker. A customer is pointing at pastries in a display case while talking to a salesclerk. The display case contains three muffins and a number of croissants; the number of croissants is double the number of muffins. The salesclerk is using tongs to pick up a Danish pastry from the case. Behind the counter, bread loaves are cooling on racks near an oven. A delivery driver is loading boxed cakes into a van parked outside the bakery. An apprentice baker is measuring flour from a large sack into a mixing bowl. A rolling pin lies on the counter next to two flour sifters; the number of flour sifters is one more than the number of rolling pins.
